decision.message: Selected esp32_bmp280_v1 board family, version 1, with low_current profile to meet the 10-kilohm I2C pull-ups at 100 kHz. Other parameters are set to the published family defaults, which are operating limits, not measured performance.

clauses.text: Make the ESP32 pressure board with 10-kilohm SDA and SCL pull-ups at 100 kHz.
clauses.reason: The request for ESP32 pressure board with 10-kilohm SDA and SCL pull-ups corresponds exactly to the low_current profile at 100 kHz bus speed.

clauses.text: All other requirements are the published family defaults.
clauses.reason: The request specifies all other requirements are the published family defaults, which matches the default envelope for the selected family and version.
